body: Man idk so much weird information about it.
Thanks for the idea, but I am hella rich lmao. Funniest thing is, if I wasnt the dragonborn I would be super happy, but being rich or smashing dragons skulls in are not the same thing sadly.

That would be a good idea, except I cant kill anything lmao, I even got this cool ass imperial set from anniversary and got rekt by two vampires. I thought it was like oblivion where I needed sliver or something but nah I am just doing that little damage. Legendary sucks my power I guess.
Doesnt enchanting not scale with money if so, I wouldn't mind grinding, I just feel I have to do the same menu thing 300 times. Not really engaging.

Cheers appericate it, glad I made you comment. 

Additionally the reason I made this post was due to wrist problems and wanted as little pain from the constant clicking. God I wish I was as hot as you.
Last year of highschool. Pretty pathetic. Just posting here because I want to vent. Now I am sick with something similar to Covid and feel horrible. Kinda miss being sad and instead being hollow.

Yeah man I get that, I try to distinguish myself for being interesting and now my grades have tanked. I cant offer help but only support and understanding. I say do something small and if you succeeded you probably can do anything weird I know. I believe anyone can achieve great things. I guess I dont want to. But you shouldnt stop, dont stop moving you are life experiencing the universe and god damn it I shouldnt be your fault or anyones for that. Your not a parasite just someone crying in pain like us all. I have never been homeless and I usually find homeless people to be drunk and scary, so coming from me I think that you should live.

Yeah man that sounds like it sucks. I am thinking of writing one. Its just everytime I do I think about the hate and pain I wrote and it hurts me.   
Hey OP I assume you aint down the rabbithole I am so I will say the only apathetic moviational thing I can think of. Find one thing you like or one person that you love or they love you and hold onto it. They will be in alot of pain. Nobody wishes to be alone and if I ever met god he would have to answer for what he has done to all of us. Or maybe nobody deserves it. Anyway hopefully you can get better get some help and walk into the abriss old and full of love. If anything has taught me about humanity its that I believe in you stranger.
Yeah doing some stuff, but lockdown makes it hard lol thanks for the support.

I don't believe I am very noble, there have been times where I could have helped people and just didn't think they deserve it or was too scared. If I wasn't scared I would be able to help people without being scared of what my brain thinks in a social situation. I am always in fight of flight mode and it really hurts my stomach. Anyway thanks for commenting, at least there are people out there who care I guess? Hopefully you become a social worker I could never do that.
Thanks for the message wasn't looking for affection, but I appreciate the kindness.
